bio.Scouting Notes:
Starter
 Had a really solid 20 game (14 starts) stretch in Low A that got him promoted to Appleton.
 Threw 4 shutout innings with 7 K’s in his first appearance. 
 Velo has been mainly in the 91 94 range, up to 96 when I've watched. 
 The slider flashes plus at times.
 The changeup is another really good secondary pitch.
 Curve is an average pitch as well, big breaker that can get as low as the high 60's, could be above average at his peak.
 Could be 4 above average to plus pitches. Really fun mix.
 Has seemed to wear down a bit later in outings, so that's something to monitor.
 Overall, he has solid results and a very interesting pitch mix as a 20 year old pitcher in High A. Lots to like.
